snippet.title: Gearbox DevCast: Borderlands 4 - Bounty Pack 2: Legend of the Stone Demon
snippet.description:
Borderlands 4’s Bounty Pack 2: Legend of the Stone Demon drops Feb. 26. Learn more here: https://borderlands.2k.com/borderland...

Borderlands 4’s second Bounty Pack, Legend of the Stone Demon, is here! Join Gearbox’s Andrew Reiner, April Johnson, and Associate Creative Director Grant Kao for the premiere of the official Gearbox DevCast. We’re diving deep into the Heart of the Mountain to discuss the massive new bounty pack and the return of Pearlescent rarity.

At Gearbox, we want you to hear it from us first. In this episode, we explain the design philosophy behind our toughest bosses (like Bloomreaper) and address community questions regarding XP farming and enemy spawn rates.

In this episode we cover: 
Legend of the Stone Demon: Explore a sprawling new zone 3x the size of Bounty Pack 1:How Rush Saved Mercenary Day.
Pearlescent Gear is Back: Learn how Ordonite-infused weapons automatically adapt to enemy vulnerabilities and where to find this new gear.

Read about this episode here: https://borderlands.2k.com/borderland...

Chapters:
0:00 – Welcome to the Gearbox DevCast
1:13 – Grant Kao’s Journey: From Battleborn to Borderlands 4
2:39 – An anecdote on Bloomreaper Raid Boss
4:11 – Legend of the Stone Demon: Setting the Stage
5:25 – Hidden Bosses & Massive New Environments
7:42 – PEARLESCENT GEAR: How it works & how to find it
11:08 – New Vault Card: Inspired Customizations
12:04 – Community Q&A

Subscribe for more developer insights and official Borderlands 4 updates.

Join the Conversation: Comment the questions you want asked in future episodes, or tag us on social media with #GearboxDevcast!
